title: ciminalis zollingeri
intro: Ciminalis zollingeri, commonly known as the Zollinger's ciminalis or poison peach, is a plant species within the Annonaceae family, known for its toxic properties. It is reported to have potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Ciminalis zollingeri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including annonacin, which has been shown to have anti-cancer properties. However, the bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, and more studies are needed to confirm its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
